text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — P1: embeddings.eu-west-1 high latency and increased 502s on /v1/embeddings. impacting customer requests, some timeouts. PagerDuty: https://pd/redwood/INC-3128
Alex R: oncall here, picking this up — I'm in the eu-west rota.
Priya S: I'm shadowing, available for infra ops.
Jamal K: I'm primary for this shift, grabbing it now. starting with runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-latency
Lin W: I'm secondary, standing by to take rollouts.
Jamal K: quick triage — what does grafana say? p95 abnormally high, and relay error rate spiking.
Alex R: seeing a lot of kv-cache evictions and a few OOMKilled on relay pods. short log snippet attached below.
```
kubectl -n inference logs relay-7b5f | tail -n 60
ERROR: OOMKilled signal received
WARN: evicted cache entries=1423
ERROR: upstream 502 from model-worker-12
```
Priya S: scaling relay replicas up to 5 in eu-west for immediate headroom: `kubectl scale deploy/relay --replicas=5 -n inference` — executing now.
Jamal K: okay, do it. we'll watch latency.
ops-bot: Deploy/scale triggered by Priya S — job id: ci-5678 — https://ci.redwood/5678
Alex R: also proposing to shift 20% traffic to quantized-2 fallback model to lower memory pressure (canary). runbook lists quantized models as supported fallback.
Jamal K: switching routing to fallback canary (20%) — `redwood route set --region eu-west-1 --model quantized-2 --canary 0.2`
Priya S: canary applied, monitoring. p95 dropping in the dashboard.
incident-bot: metric alert update: p95 latency dropped from 3.4s -> 0.92s over 7m since replica bump + canary — :white_check_mark:
Lin W: 502s have stopped, no 504s in last 10m. confirmed from synthetic checks.
Alex R: good. keep increased replica count for 30m then gradually scale down if stable. Priya can you file a ticket to track root cause and follow-ups?
Priya S: filed RW-3421: "eu-west embeddings latency — kv-cache thrash and relay OOM" assigned to infra. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/RW-3421
Jamal K: adding mitigation notes to RW-3421 (timeline, canary switch, scale commands, logs).
Alex R: we should also run a quick config audit: cache size, eviction policy, and relays' mem requests/limits.
Priya S: started grabbing config snapshots and mem metrics.
Jamal K: small customer-impact check — does anyone see increased client timeouts or error reports in intercom?
Alex R: I see 3 customer support tickets flagged high priority, forwarded to success team. no billing impacts reported.
Lin W: created a short alert dashboard for kv cache occupancy and eviction rates. adding to runbook.
Priya S: action items created in ticket RW-3421 and linked child tickets: RW-3422 (autoscale qa), RW-3423 (playbook update).
Alex R: schedule a post-mortem / retro with infra, infra-sre, product next week. propose Mon 09:00 PT. Priya please create calendar invite and add owners.
Priya S: calendar invite sent to infra, product, eng-oncall. retro doc created: https://redwood.internal/retros/eu-embeddings-3128
Jamal K: checklist for handoff: put primary/secondary in the ticket, list mitigations done, attach logs, confirm no regressions for 30m.
Alex R: note coverage gap: APAC night shift didn't have an embeddings shadow; please update rotation so APAC window has a dedicated shadow for model-serving incidents.
Priya S: updating SRE rotation doc now — will add extra shadow for APAC night window and notify rota.
Lin W: I'll add a short pre-handoff checklist line to the runbook so future handoffs call out primary/secondary explicitly.
Jamal K: oncall handoff: I'm primary until 2026-03-16 08:00 UTC; Lin W is secondary. leaving mitigation notes in RW-3421 and dashboards pinned.
incident-bot: Incident status changed to MITIGATED at 3128887802 — mitigation summary: scaled relays, applied canary to fallback model, mitigated OOM/evictions.
Alex R: post-handoff follow ups logged: RW-3421 + RW-3422 + RW-3423. priority action: increase mem requests for relays and adjust cache eviction thresholds.
Priya S: starting follow-up ticket for rotation gap: RW-3424 — APAC shadow coverage add.
Jamal K: I'll annotate timing and root-cause hypotheses in RW-3421 and attach heap/profile dumps.
Alex R: thanks all — leave any other notes here before the handoff. if no more, I'll close the incident thread after handoff. :raised_hands:
Priya S: nothing else from me, monitoring dashboards for 15 more mins then I'll scale replica down gradually if stable.
Lin W: acknowledged, I'll pick up at handoff and keep an eye on the canary.
Alex R: closing notes: please remember to call out primary/secondary in future handoffs explicitly in the status message to avoid APAC gaps.
Jamal K: noted. RW-3421 updated.
Alex R: closing incident thread. good job everyone.
